# Maatify Channel Delivery

> Standalone PHP Composer project/service for asynchronous email, keyed atomic acceptance and isolated no-send recording. Email is implemented; other channels are planned.

## Consumer documentation
- [README](README.md): published release identity, live publication record, requirements and entry points.
- [Usage guide](docs/guides/USAGE_GUIDE.md): setup and operation selection.
- [HTTP reference](docs/CHANNEL_DELIVERY_API.md): endpoint navigation and template catalogue.
- [Atomic v2](docs/api/email-atomic.md): Idempotency-Key, receipts and uncertain acceptance recovery.
- [Synthetic](docs/api/email-synthetic.md): inert recording, retention and consumer timing boundary.
- [Examples](examples/README.md): runnable trusted-client examples and shared decoy payload.
- [Configuration](docs/reference/configuration.md): actual environment reads and operator CLI.
- [Upgrade](docs/upgrade/2.0.0.md): PHP compatibility break and explicit schema adoption.

## Release and community
- [Published 2.0.0](docs/releases/2.0.0.md): published-source evidence, compatibility and curated notes.
- [Qualification checklist](docs/releases/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md): exact-SHA gates and archive verification before publication.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): support and private reporting.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): source-clone verification.

This file is navigation only, not contributor instructions or a second runtime contract. Do not infer publication, deployment, constant-time behavior or mailbox delivery from a merge, tag, receipt or local test.
